correctness.rationale: The source-dependent hypotheses were checked in Szabó arXiv:2609.34042v1: the degree-three factorization has four nonseparating and three separating vanishing cycles; all algebraic intersections are divisible by 3; the Picard--Lefschetz first-homology formula and global monodromy relation are given; and the total-space fundamental group is Z^2. The standard Lefschetz-handle quotient makes the integral vanishing lattice primitive of rank two. Reducing modulo 3 therefore gives a Lagrangian plane. The product relation becomes a zero sum of four rank-one symmetric forms, which forces the four projective directions exactly once; those forms span Sym_2(F_3), so the image is the full 27-element unipotent subgroup. The finite calculation was replayed from artifacts/verify_mod3_monodromy.py.

value.rationale: The exact congruence image is a natural invariant of a distinguished small genus-two Lefschetz fibration. Identifying it as the full Lagrangian unipotent radical of order 27, together with the exact four projective vanishing directions, is structurally stronger than the routine observation that isotropic transvections commute and provides a concrete arithmetic datum for comparison of congruence covers and constructions using this factorization.
